name: Turbosmart Boost Tee Manual Boost Controller
title: Turbosmart Boost Tee Manual Boost Controller
description:
The TS-0101-1101 Turbosmart Boost Tee is a reliable, budget-friendly manual boost controller designed to increase boost pressure above base wastegate level.

Technical Specifications:

Adjustment Mechanism: Mechanical detent system with positive index clicks for precise boost adjustment.

Gated Design: Integrated detent system prevents boost spikes and speeds up wastegate spool-up by delaying gate crack pressure.

Construction: CNC-machined anodized billet aluminum body with stainless steel internal components.

Connections: Dual 1/8" NPT fittings with brass hose barbs for easy inline installation into wastegate pressure lines.

Mounting: Includes a heavy-duty mounting bracket for secure engine bay placement.

name: Turbosmart Boost Gauge 30psi 52mm
title: Turbosmart Boost Gauge 30psi 52mm
description:
The TS-0101-2023 is a reliable 52mm mechanical boost gauge engineered for accurate real-time manifold pressure and vacuum monitoring up to 30 PSI.

Technical Specifications:

Scale & Range: Mechanical vacuum to 30 PSI display.

Dial & Lighting: High-contrast black face with a sleek silver bezel and bright backlighting for easy viewing day or night.

Size & Fitment: Standard 52mm (2-1/16") diameter for seamless pod or dash mounting.

Operation: 100% mechanical sweep—requires no electronic sensors for direct manifold pressure reading.

Includes: Comes complete with panel mounting bracket, vacuum line, and brass T-fitting.

name: Turbosmart Dual Stage Boost Controller V2
title: Turbosmart Dual Stage Boost Controller V2
description:
Fast, reliable on-the-fly boost switching. The Dual Stage Boost Controller V2 lets you toggle between a conservative street setting and full track boost at the flip of a switch.

Features
Instant Dual-Stage Switching: Switch between two independent boost settings (Low/High) via an in-cabin 12V toggle.

Faster Spool: Closed-loop pneumatic design prevents premature wastegate opening to eliminate lag.

Precision Tuning: Knurled adjustment dials with positive detents prevent setting drift under vibration.

Billet Construction: CNC-machined 6061-T6 aluminum body with 1/8" NPT ports built for high heat and zero leaks.

Specs
Range: 0–30+ PSI (wastegate spring dependent)

Ports: 1/8" NPT with brass barbs

Compatibility: Internal and external wastegates

Includes: Controller, 12V solenoid, toggle switch, wiring, barbs, and mounting bracket.

name: Turbosmart BOV Kompact Dual Port
title: Turbosmart BOV Kompact Dual Port
description:
The Turbosmart Kompact Dual Port BOV is a direct-replacement performance blow-off valve designed to upgrade weak, plastic factory bypass valves.

Its hybrid Dual Port design vents both to the atmosphere for a crisp BOV sound and back into the intake to keep ECU air-metering clean and avoid rich running conditions or fault codes.

Features
Dual Port Hybrid Venting: Reroutes part of the charge air into the intake and vents the rest to atmosphere for BOV sound without ECU issues.

Holds High Boost: Billet aluminum body and internal brass piston eliminate high-boost leaks common on OEM plastic diaphragms.

Sharper Response: Quick-acting piston reduces turbo lag between gear shifts and protects the compressor wheel against surge.

Direct Bolt-On: Engineered to mount using factory manifold locations and vacuum connections.

Specs
Material: CNC-machined 6061-T6 billet aluminum body.

Internal: Anodized high-flow aluminum/brass piston with high-temp seals.

Compatibility: Universal NPT hose barb models or vehicle-specific direct-fit options available.

In the Box: Kompact Dual Port BOV, mounting hardware, and vacuum line adapter.

name: Turbosmart eBS eBoost Street 40psi
title: Turbosmart eBS eBoost Street 40psi
description:
The Turbosmart eBoost Street is a high-performance 40 PSI electronic boost controller engineered to deliver precise, dual-stage boost control with maximum stability and fast turbo response.

Features
Dual Boost Modes: Easily switch between two independent boost settings (e.g., Low / High) on the fly using the front button or external switch input.

40 PSI Max Pressure: Built to handle high-boost applications with precision resolution and zero pressure drop.

Fast Spooling Gate Feature: Eliminates premature wastegate creeping to maximize turbine energy and dramatically reduce turbo lag.

Overboost Protection: Programmable safety cutoff automatically reduces boost to protect engine and turbo components from spike damage.

Compact 52mm Gauge Style: Sleek design fits standard 52mm (2-1/16") gauge pods or dash mounts with an easy-to-read digital display.

Specs
Max Pressure: 40 PSI / 2.75 Bar

Mounting Size: Standard 52mm (2-1/16")

Inputs/Outputs: External boost mode switch input, auxiliary output (e.g., shift light or water/meth activation)

Compatibility: Internal and external wastegates (single or twin turbo)

Includes: eBoost Street control unit, 3-port solenoid, wiring harness, vacuum hose, and mounting hardware

name: Turbosmart FPR Gauge 0-100psi
title: Turbosmart FPR Gauge 0-100psi
description:
The Turbosmart 0–100 PSI Liquid-Filled Fuel Pressure Gauge is engineered for precise fuel system monitoring and tuning. Its liquid-filled body dampens internal engine vibrations and fuel line pressure spikes, giving you an easy-to-read needle display.

Features
Liquid-Filled Dampening: Liquid-filled housing stabilizes the needle against engine vibration and fuel pulses for accurate readings.

High-Contrast Face: White face dial with clear markings for rapid monitoring under any lighting.

Universal 1/8" NPT Fitment: Threads directly into standard 1/8" NPT gauge ports on aftermarket FPRs, fuel rails, or distribution blocks.

Direct FPR Compatibility: Fits Turbosmart FPR and OPR series regulators (including FPR800, FPR1200, FPR2000, and FPR3000).

Specs
Pressure Range: 0 – 100 PSI

Thread Port: 1/8" Male NPT

Gauge Diameter: 1.5" (38mm)

Dial Type: White Face / Analog Mechanical

Filling: Liquid Filled

name: Turbosmart FPR6 - Fuel Pressure Regulator - Black
title: Turbosmart FPR6 - Fuel Pressure Regulator - Black
description:
The Turbosmart FPR6 Series Fuel Pressure Regulator (-6AN, Black) provides market-leading fuel control with a true 1:1 manifold pressure reference ratio for high-performance EFI setups up to 1200 HP.

Features
1:1 Manifold Reference: Delivers smooth, linear fuel pressure tracking relative to boost/vacuum changes.

All-Fuel Compatible: Built with a stainless steel valve seat and Mil-Spec diaphragm to safely handle gas, ethanol (E85), methanol, and race fuel.

Precision Adjustability: Features a locking collar adjustment mechanism to easily set base fuel pressure.

Integrated Gauge Port: Includes a dedicated 1/8" NPT port for mounting a fuel pressure gauge or electronic sensor.

Billet Aluminum Body: CNC-machined aluminum housing with a durable black anodized finish.

Specs
Pressure Range: Standard EFI (35 – 80 PSI)

Port Configuration: -6AN ORB Inlet, Outlet, and Return Ports

Gauge Port: 1/8" NPT Female

Power Rating: Rated for fuel systems up to 1200 HP

Color: Black

name: Turbosmart FPR8 - Fuel Pressure Regulator - Black
title: Turbosmart FPR8 - Fuel Pressure Regulator - Black
description:
The Turbosmart FPR8 Series Fuel Pressure Regulator (-8AN, Black) is engineered for high-demand, high-horsepower EFI fuel delivery systems. Designed with high bypass capacity to handle fuel systems supporting up to 2000 HP, it delivers smooth and stable 1:1 boost-referenced fuel pressure control.

Features
1:1 Boost-Referenced Ratio: Delivers rapid, linear fuel pressure tracking relative to manifold pressure changes.

High Bypass Capacity: Built for -8AN plumbing to support high-flow fuel setups up to 2000 HP.

All-Fuel Compatible: Features a stainless steel valve seat and Mil-Spec diaphragm to safely run pump gas, E85, ethanol, methanol, and race fuel.

Locking Collar Adjuster: Precision screw and locking collar mechanism allow fast base pressure tuning that stays set.

Auxiliary Sensor Port: Includes a 1/8" NPT port for a fuel pressure gauge or standalone ECU pressure sensor.

Specs
Pressure Range: Standard EFI (35 – 80 PSI)

Port Configuration: -8AN ORB Inlet, Outlet, and Return Ports

Gauge/Sensor Port: 1/8" NPT Female

Power Rating: Rated for systems up to 2000 HP

Body Material: CNC-machined 6061-T6 billet aluminum

Color: Black Anodized

name: Turbosmart GenV WG40/45 CompGate40
title: Turbosmart GenV WG40/45 CompGate40
description:
The Turbosmart Gen-V External Wastegate Series is a motorsport-proven line of external wastegates engineered for precise boost control, maximum flow capacity, and extended thermal performance. Featuring a 360-degree rotatable actuator cap, optional liquid-cooling ports, and a modular locking-collar cap system, the Gen-V series is built for demanding high-heat performance environments.

Key Features
Gen-V Modular Architecture: 360-degree clockable actuator housing allows easy reference hose routing in cramped engine bays.

Advanced Thermal Management: Features a Nitronic 60 valve guide and 347 stainless steel body to eliminate valve sticking under extreme exhaust temperatures.

High-Flow Efficiency: CFD-designed body profile provides class-leading flow capacity and minimal backpressure.

Optional Liquid Cooling: Integrated ports allow optional coolant line routing for extreme heat applications.

Included Components: Supplied with V-band inlet/outlet flanges, strap clamps, seat, and collar adjustment tool.

Variant Options Included in Series
WG40 Comp-Gate40 (40mm / 7 PSI) — Black (SKU: TS-0552-1002)
Compact 40mm body with a pre-installed 7 PSI spring setup for street and mild track builds.

WG40 Comp-Gate40 (40mm / 14 PSI) — Black (SKU: TS-0552-1012)
Compact 40mm body with a pre-installed 14 PSI spring setup for higher base boost applications.

WG45 Hyper-Gate45 (45mm / 14 PSI) — Black (SKU: TS-0553-1012)
High-capacity 45mm body with a pre-installed 14 PSI spring setup for high-horsepower setups needing massive exhaust bypass flow.
